senses.gloss: a. Involving no humiliation or self-degradation [[Bh. 3. 144.]]

a. 
(-वी f.) 
__1 Not predestined or predetermined (by Gods or by Fate). 
__2 Not connected with the Gods or their action, not divine; अदैवं भोजयेच्छ्राद्धम् [[Ms. 3. 247]] ([[Kull.]] वैश्वदेवब्राह्मणभोजनरहितम्). 
__3 Unfortunate, ill-fated.
